summary: Re-ran iteration-160 visual/SEO/cards/flow regression on local OpenNext worker (http://127.0.0.1:8787). Functional flows passed (home/products/detail/finder/search/filter/gallery/compare/RFQ/contact), backend contracts passed, but strict network-noise gate failed due recurring net::ERR_ABORTED on _rsc and /api/track during rapid navigation.

integration_issues.issue: 11 failed RSC requests observed as net::ERR_ABORTED (e.g., /products?...&_rsc=..., /contact?...&_rsc=..., /signatouch?_rsc=...). This violates zero-failed-request gate.

7 /api/track requests marked net::ERR_ABORTED during route transitions when sendBeacon was forced off for inspection, despite payloads being generated; zero-failed-request requirement for /api/track is not met.

action_items: Eliminate client-side aborted _rsc prefetch requests under rapid route changes (prefetch policy currently still allows speculative requests on non-product-card links).
Harden analytics transport so /api/track requests are not emitted as failed/aborted during navigation-heavy flows (especially fallback path).
Re-run rapid-navigation gate and require zero requestfailed entries for both /api/track and _rsc URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: No MOCKED APIs were used; all checks hit live local worker endpoints.

Prefetch disabling is implemented on product cards and some SEO links, but remaining Next Link surfaces (header/product detail/other internal links) still trigger speculative _rsc requests that can abort under fast navigation.
analytics.ts fallback uses keepalive fetch during navigation; this transport still shows aborted-request noise in automation traces under rapid route changes.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all requested functional flows passed; strict network-noise gate failed)

seed_data_creation: Submitted contact lead via UI: qa.iter161@brightluxx-example.test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Functional parity remains green: concise key H1s, 235 generic route content blocks, 94 products SSR/cards on desktop/tablet/mobile, finder/search/filter, product gallery, compare/RFQ/contact all passed. Remaining blocker is strict noise gate: requestfailed logs still include _rsc aborts and /api/track aborts in navigation-heavy traces.
rca of the issue: RCA: net::ERR_ABORTED is reproduced during quick route transitions where in-flight RSC/speculative requests and analytics sends are canceled by client navigation lifecycle. Product-card prefetch=false reduced one source, but not all Link surfaces are constrained, so _rsc aborts persist. Analytics sendBeacon path avoids visible body capture and fallback fetch path still exhibits aborted requests during rapid transitions. Repro: rapidly navigate / -> /products -> detail -> /compare -> /contact while tracking requestfailed events; observe repeated *_rsc and /api/track abort entries. Mitigation direction: unify prefetch strategy for all critical links and ensure analytics dispatch is cancellation-safe/noise-free across route transitions.
